Our services

One integrated process, from simulation to production.

We bring offline engineering, robot programming, PLC logic and commissioning together to reduce surprises and make the move to production smoother.

Offline engineering

Cell design, sequence planning, path verification and process optimisation before work starts on the physical line.

Robot programming

We program, tune and optimise industrial robots from multiple manufacturers, with a focus on quality and cycle times.

PLC software and networks

Support for PLC development and integration, process interfaces and industrial communications.

Commissioning

Onsite start-up, plant and production integration, troubleshooting and support until the line is stable.

A continuous engineering workflow connects the virtual model to conditions on the production line.

A²MEngineering Flow
Our approach

Prepare early.
Start up smoothly.

We start with your goals and keep the team, software and plant aligned. Each step sets up the next.

PHASE 01

Understand the process

Together with you, we review workflows, standards, line constraints and expected outcomes.

PHASE 02

Design offline

We prepare the digital cell, sequences and programs, checking access and robot paths.

PHASE 03

Integrate onsite

We bring the work to the shop floor, aligning robots, PLCs and networks with real plant conditions.

PHASE 04

Stabilise production

We refine cycle times and quality with the line team through to production start-up.

We can support a single phase or coordinate the full process.
